LESSON: CONSTRUCTING FRAMED SUSPENDED GARDEN

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Constructing Framed Suspended Garden

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Constructing Framed Suspended Garden
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are framed suspended gardens constructed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe a framed suspended garden for growing crops
2. construct a framed structure for a suspended garden

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Constructing Framed Suspended Garden

Teach
• Observe Constructing Framed Suspended Garden in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Constructing Framed Suspended Garden (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Constructing Framed Suspended Garden.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Constructing Framed Suspended Garden.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Constructing Framed Suspended Garden.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe a framed suspended garden for growing crops
• construct a framed structure for a suspended garden

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Constructing Framed Suspended Garden.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Constructing Framed Suspended Garden: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are framed suspended gardens constructed?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe a framed suspended garden for growing crops
• construct a framed structure for a suspended garden

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
